newsitem.title: USA: Mrs. Clinton will leave for Africa Sunday.
newsitem.headline: Mrs. Clinton will leave for Africa Sunday.

text.p: Hillary Rodham Clinton decided on Friday to postpone her departure for a six-nation Africa tour by one day until Sunday because of President Bill Clinton's knee surgery, her office said.
A spokesman for the first lady, Neel Lattimore, said Mrs. Clinton would depart on Sunday morning instead of Saturday morning but would still carry out a full schedule on the two-week trip.

Lattimore said Mrs. Clinton would have to condense some events on her first stop, in Senegal, but wanted to be with her husband as he begins a long recovery from surgery to reattach a torn tendon to his right kneecap.
"She wants to be with her husband. It's the only thing on her mind right now. Her priorities are just right," Lattimore said.
Mrs. Clinton during her goodwill mission will also visit South Africa, Zimbabwe, Uganda, Tanzania and Eritrea.
